The Thomson Reuters Risk and Fraud (TR R&F) is a suite of solutions and are designed to identify risk and streamline investigations for Government agencies in the United States Federal, State, Local, and Tribal Agencies.
TR R&F offers customers enhanced security, availability, compliance, and support to help deliver a mission-critical edge in a secure cloud environment.  
 The TR R&F suite currently consists of: Thomson Reuters CLEAR
•        Thomson Reuters CLEAR is software designed to streamline data analysis and reporting by providing a single interface to access and connect critical data sources, including public and proprietary records. The platform's customizable dashboards and detailed reporting capabilities allow users to stay informed and make data-driven decisions.
